name: casa-nostra
description: App per la gestione della divisione spese famigliare

paragraphs: Mobile-first web app for transparently managing household expenses between two cohabiting partners. Every expense entered is shared by definition: 50/50 for rent, 60/40 for everything else (the partner with the higher income pays 60%). The app always shows the current balance and lets you settle it in one tap.

It also keeps a shopping list — what's missing at home, by product type, quantity and urgency — with a receipt check that reads a photo of a receipt, ticks off what was bought and highlights what's still missing. The list can be managed from the app, from the AI assistant, or straight from the Telegram group.
For a full guide to the architecture, domain models, and patterns used in the project, see the Developer Wiki (in Italian).
